description: AMIU Puglia describes fixed municipal waste-collection centres in Bari, Italy, including their locations, service information and opening hours. Separate CSV and JSON resources cover centre identifiers and geographic coordinates, accepted waste categories with EER/CER codes, opening hours by centre and weekday, and quantitative delivery limits. CSV dictionaries accompany these resource families. The stated limits apply to authorised domestic and non-domestic users under the AMIU centre-management regulation. They are delivery rules, with no established relationship to hourly processing capacity. Facility locations, schedules and admission rules provide inputs for waste-service capacity planning. The metadata was modified on 14 July 2026; the observation period, positional accuracy and coordinate reference system are unspecified. The provider states Creative Commons Attribution without a version. Cost and download access conditions remain unverified. Public metadata and resource descriptions were inspected without downloading files. Bari mobile collection stations are described in a separate related record.
